agentSessions.import.note: tests/agent_sessions.rs: imports transcripts of the last 30 days (max 100) as threads with the last 200 text messages and the native session id so the provider resumes; idempotent. Tool calls and thinking are not reconstructed; transcripts are never written.

agentSessions.scan.note: tests/agent_sessions.rs: scans $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects and $CODEX_HOME/sessions (bounded files/bytes/line length, read-only, nothing cached), groups by directory, reports matching projects and alreadyImported.

assets.createUrl.note: Real-client signed grants cover all resource tags, Range and HEAD, and session, scope and canonical-boundary rechecks. Media kinds the desktop classifier accepts, including .aac, .opus, .avi and .ogv, download through real asset readers; playback itself is client codec behavior. MCP HTML injection has no production caller.

attachments.delete.note: Real-client test: removes pending uploads (and .txt sidecar), idempotent, ignores non-pending or malformed ids. Upload route: streamed to a .part file, exact size, 204, 409 on conflicting duplicate.

orchestration.dispatchCommand.note: Actual client Command, approval, queue, timeline, sidebar and awareness readers execute on server output; acceptForSession survives idle reap; imported native references share launch validation. Native control delivery has no exactly-once acknowledgement: uncertain handoffs are recorded as delivery-unknown, never replayed. Accepted limits: other-owner and delegated-cohort cases with no client flow; RECOVERY.md's exact original-process reattachment. See CONFORMANCE.md. 2026-11-02 audit implementation: historical fresh forks materialize bounded uploaded attachments and serialized historical context, excluding later runs; deterministic Claude/Codex peers assert provider-received image bytes and timeline reader output. Per-message provider selection shares identity reset/handoff with explicit selection; same-instance model changes retain identity. tests/model_handoff.rs includes failing-before controls. Oversize handoffs fail explicitly; arbitrary native context beyond stored conversation remains unproven.

orchestration.getArchivedShellSnapshot.note: Queries only archived nondeleted rows; does not construct active shell rows or copy message text. Existing readers have no archive pagination mechanism. See dated measurements and remaining size limits in CONFORMANCE.md.

orchestration.getFullThreadDiff.note: Real Connection Codex execution captures Git refs and verifies baseline-to-turn diff. Checkpoint retention and overlapping-workspace isolation remain.

orchestration.getOlderSettledThreads.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: pages settled top-level threads below the cursor (settledAt desc, id asc), limit 0 returns per-project counts, project filter. Snapshots never omit older settled threads, so capabilities.shellOlderSettled stays false.

orchestration.getThreadFamily.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.getThreadProjection.note: Real-client test: bounded projection (up to 100 rows per kind) and an error for unknown threads.

orchestration.getTurnDiff.note: Real Connection Codex execution captures baseline/end refs using a private Git index; test verifies diff over a real workspace change. Includes untracked nonignored files and deletions; non-Git workspaces report unavailable.

orchestration.getTurnItem.note: Real-client test: item by id for its own thread, null otherwise. The revision argument is ignored.

orchestration.getWorkflowScript.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: reads .js files below $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR|~/.claude/projects, 256 KiB cap, T3's typed OrchestrationGetWorkflowScriptError reasons.

orchestration.getWorktreeThreadIds.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.launchThread.note: Automatic generateTitle launches preserve fallback titles even with unsupported saved Codex text generation; no provider substitution. Real Connection/title readers cover this and explicit regeneration errors. Pinned 3991 accepts saved selection and empty automatic launch; full initial-message generation on reference is unproven. Broader parity remains subject to independent audit.

orchestration.searchThread.note: Implemented and tested with a real Connection, but no production caller: desktop ui/qml/T3Panel.qml:193 and Android ui/thread/TimelineReader.kt:87 search the loaded transcript locally, and lib-t3-rust has no RPC reader for it. Reclassified by independent audit on 2026-11-02.

orchestration.searchThreadStream.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.searchThreads.note: Real search readers cover metadata, shells, filters, positive message results and ordering compared on pinned 3991, match-centered UTF-8 snippets including composed and decomposed accents, and long messages. FTS queries run folded and raw because the index stores raw text. No wall-clock deadline exists for FTS ranking; no client failure was reproduced from it.

orchestration.stopWorkflow.note: No provider control stops a workflow; answers OrchestrationV2StopWorkflowError(unsupported). tests/admin_reads.rs.

orchestration.subscribeArchivedShell.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.subscribeCommandOutput.note: Real live and settled output readers cover bounded tails, replacement and final output, and multi-line redraws, with adversarial bounds kept. Completion-only native Claude delivery is not a dropped delta.

orchestration.subscribeShell.note: Shell message summaries match sampled pinned V2 null rather than copying message bodies; all live threads retained. HTTP and real stream reader regression covers 375 long messages. Unbounded thread counts/metadata can still exceed client 8 MiB; see CONFORMANCE.md. Remaining besides a real quota-exhausted capture: a complete shell has no pagination and exceeds the client's 8 MiB limit around 10,000 threads with long titles (lib-t3-rust lib.rs:86), far beyond today's 375; raising it or paginating is client work.

orchestration.subscribeThread.note: Real lib reducers and timeline, queue, approval, compaction-candidate and sidebar readers run on server output. Gated Codex vs isolated T3 3991 passes strictly: two subscribers, request-before-result window, unique run creation, terminal causality, exact replay order and identity, stable ID relationships. One recorded reference-only exception: lastSnoozeWakeAt null-to-absent in T3's replay, which no client reads. Reader-state equality, not JSON equality of every record. Accepted limits: other-owner and delegated-cohort cases with no client flow; RECOVERY.md's exact original-process reattachment. See concurrent-reader-report.json and CONFORMANCE.md. Audit follow-up: historical text/tool results now truncate oldest-first with a marker at 1 MiB; attachment overflow still rejects explicitly. Native latest forks skip fallback-only limits.

No enabled o3 production caller or consumed cleanup gap found; recommend independent priority/status review, unchanged here.
